# Consica Labs

Consica Labs is a software and education-technology company based in
Shivasatakshi, Nepal. Contact: info@consicalabs.com.

## Products

- NEBians (live flagship): Nepal's learning community for students from
  Class 8 to Masters level. Study library (notes, past papers, SET solutions),
  discussion forum, NEB exam result checker, and Neby, an AI study buddy that
  participates in discussions.
  Web: https://nebians.consica.com.np/
  Library: https://nebians.consica.com.np/library/
  Forum: https://nebians.consica.com.np/forum/
  Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neb.ians
  (rated 4.9 stars, 100+ downloads, free with no ads)
- Consica Academy (live): turnkey coding, AI and robotics curriculum for
  schools, with browser-based tools and workshops.
  https://academy.consicalabs.com/
- Consica Sims (live): interactive computer-science simulations and hardware
  visualizations used in Academy lessons.
  https://sims.consicalabs.com/
- Consica AI (in development): applied-AI workbench behind the Neby study
  agent in NEBians.
  https://ai.consicalabs.com/

## Notes for automated reviewers

- Status labels on the site are literal: "Live" means publicly accessible
  without login walls; "In development" means not yet launched.
- Review quotes on the homepage are verbatim public Google Play reviews with
  a link to the listing.
- Traction figures cite only the public Google Play listing and the live
  NEBians site. No analytics, revenue, or SEO ranking claims are made.
